output.reason: The evidence shows that the directions include rules on levying pre-payment charges for floating-rate business-purpose loans granted to individuals and Micro and Small Enterprises (including with or without co-obligants), and that a Tier 3 UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges on loans up to ₹50 lakh. However, the evidence does not state whether the directions provide or do not provide an interest-rate ceiling, so that part of the claim is not fully supported.
